messages.subject: Renewable Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG and External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Lorenzi,

Your partner-led executive-search focus across renewable energy and infrastructure is relevant to my international leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where energy-transition growth requires regulatory alignment, stakeholder trust and disciplined execution. I am internationally mobile and open to appropriate senior appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
